name: Brain Burn
text: BRAIN BURN Target wizard may discard any number of cards from his hand (including any of his maintained spells) that he desires. The target then suffers magical damage equal to the number of cards left in his hand (including any of his maintained spells, but excluding carried items).

name: Share Life
text: Share Life Add your current life and target wizard's current life together, and then divide the total life evenly between the two wizards. If there is an odd total, you receive the extra point of life. A

name: Add
text: Add Combine the energy values of 2 Magic cards together and use them to boost 1 of your spells or actions. No further energy values can be added to them. 3

name: Pick Lock
text: Pick Lock. Mundane Unlock target door momentarily. The door re-locks after you pass through it, although you may "hold the door open" for others while you are adjacent to the door. Mundane actions cannot be countered. 3

name: Shield

text: PSYCHIC STORM Strike target square and all adjacent squares (even through walls, but not diagonals) with a howling storm of power.
